subject.title: fix(repair): cut over durable cluster intake publication

question: Should this PR remain stacked on https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/884 while its recovery authority is redesigned around canonical accepted-intent receipts, or should the cutover be split and rebased only after that contract lands?
rationale: The remaining choice determines whether mutable Git state may influence dispatch recovery, which is an authority boundary rather than a routine workflow edit.

options.title: Rebase after canonical receipt recovery
options.body: Keep this PR open, complete the canonical accepted-intent receipt design in the parent PR, then rebase this workflow cutover onto that settled contract.

options.title: Split the cutover
options.body: Land only a narrowly safe publication/credential cutover after removing any dependency on the unresolved parent recovery behavior.

recommendation.title: Rebase after canonical receipt recovery
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, complete the canonical accepted-intent receipt design in the parent PR, then rebase this workflow cutover onto that settled contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The maintainer review explicitly connects this decision to the canonical Durable Object state model introduced by recent state work.
